#include <cstdio>
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;
typedef long long llong;
#define maxn 1000010
const llong MOD = 1e9 + 7;
bool vis[maxn];

int main() {
    int p, k, _k;
    scanf("%d%d", &p, &k);
    llong ans = 1;
    if (k != 0) {
        if (k == 1) ans = p;
        for (int i=1; i<p; i++) {
            if ((llong)i * k % p == 1) {
                _k = i;
                break;
            }
        }

        for (int i=1; i<p; i++) if (!vis[i]) {
            vis[i] = true;
            int x = 1;
            int j = (llong)k*i % p;
            int m = _k;
            while (!vis[j]) {
                vis[j] = true;
                x++;
                m = (llong)m * _k % p;
                j = (llong)k*j % p;
            }
            if (m == 1) ans = (llong)ans * p % MOD;
        }
    } else {
        for (int i=1; i<p; i++) ans = (llong)ans * p % MOD;
    }
    cout<< ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
